text: {"final": {"verdict": "accept", "reason": "The step matches the code and ticket. routes_between, best_route (min by (km, id), DEFAULT_VEHICLE='truck'), and sites_served (sorted) all exist in logistics/routes.py as the findings state. access.py confirms STATUS_CODES A/R/X and VEHICLE_WEIGHT truck=heavy/van=light, so can_pass semantics in the plan (van-only on 'R', unusable on 'X') are right. network.json confirms R11: RT-02 (R-03='R') van-only, RT-05 (R-08='X') unusable with RT-06 the usable van route, RT-07 (R-12='X') unusable with RT-08 the usable truck route, RT-09 (R-13='R') van-only; best_route currently picks RT-02/RT-05/RT-07 with trucks. passable_route as planned (usable if any vehicle passes every road, shortest by (km, id), truck if truck passes all roads else van, None otherwise) and rerouted_sites (compare passable_route's route vs best_route's route, vehicle-only change not counted, name order via sorted sites_served) fulfil the ticket's routing requirements without touching best_route."}}
reasoning:
The plan step: passable_route uses routes_between, checks can_pass for each vehicle, picks shortest usable by (km, id), returns truck if truck can pass all roads else van. That matches the ticket. rerouted_sites iterates sites_served for "the warehouse(s) served" — slightly vague but reasonable; compares routes. One subtlety: rerouted_sites needs to know which warehouse serves which site; iterating sites_served(warehouse_id) per warehouse. The plan says "iterate sites_served(warehouse_id, network) (already sorted, giving name order) for the warehouse(s) served". sites_served returns sorted list — correct. The comparison: passable_route route vs best_route route, include when differs. That matches ticket.

One potential issue: passable_route's vehicle choice — ticket says "sending a truck if a truck may use every road on that route and a van otherwise". Plan matches. Also "Among usable routes pick the shortest using the same ordering as best_route" — matches.

Edge: what if a route is usable only by van but best_route picks a different route? Fine.

R11 findings check against data: RT-02 roads R-01(A), R-03(R) → van-only, correct. RT-05 R-07(A), R-08(X) → unusable, correct. RT-06 R-07(A), R-09(R) → van-only usable, correct. RT-07 R-10(A), R-12(X) → unusable. RT-08 R-10, R-11 both A → truck usable. RT-09 R-13(R) → van-only. best_route picks RT-02 (only route to SITE-NVL-B? No, RT-03 also 31km; min is RT-02 22km), RT-05 (18km vs RT-06 26km), RT-07 (20 vs 27). Correct.

The plan step seems correct. One thing: rerouted_sites signature in ticket is rerouted_sites(network=None) -> list[str], and plan says iterate sites_served for "the warehouse(s) served" — how to determine warehouses? Not specified precisely, but that's a minor implementation detail; the step as written would do its part. Accept.
